# GENERATED by tools/gen.py - do not edit by hand, edit the generator and re-run it.
# The sub-ideology name lapses when the ruling party changes (election, coup,
# set_politics) and, checked daily, when the ruling sub-ideology changes without a
# party change (a new leader). CAPIE already shows the game's name then (CONTRACT
# section 20); removing the variables keeps the name from coming back. No cooldown.
on_actions = {
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = capie_sn_ver } rn_subideology_name_carrier_clear = yes }
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = capie_sn_ver } rn_si_daily_check = yes }
		}
	}
}
